title: Finite-support linear model and bracket for a loop Lie algebra
statement:
Let $L$ be a rational Lie algebra [def-wf-lie-algebra] and let $\Gamma$ be an abelian group written additively. Let $A=\mathbf Q[\Gamma]$ be the rational vector space of finite formal sums $\sum_\gamma a_\gamma e_\gamma$, with bilinear multiplication $e_\gamma e_\delta=e_{\gamma+\delta}$ and unit $e_0$. It is a commutative rational algebra. With tensor products as in [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], $C=A\otimes_{\mathbf Q}L$ is a rational Lie algebra with bilinear bracket
$$[a\otimes u,b\otimes v]=ab\otimes[u,v].$$
There is a rational linear isomorphism $\Theta:C\xrightarrow{\sim}\Gamma\to_0 L$, where $\Gamma\to_0L$ is the vector space of finitely supported functions $\Gamma\to L$ with pointwise addition and scalar multiplication, such that
$$\Theta(e_\gamma\otimes u)=\operatorname{single}_\gamma(u).$$
Here $\operatorname{single}_\gamma(u)$ takes value $u$ at $\gamma$ and zero elsewhere. No finite generation, torsion-freeness or ordering of $\Gamma$, and no finite dimensionality of $L$, is required.

mathlib_match.how: One declaration per clause, specializing R to Q, the additive monoid to Gamma, and the Lie module M to L with its adjoint action. AddMonoidAlgebra is the finite-support coefficient space (Defs.lean:60--69); AddMonoidAlgebra.commRing is generated from MonoidAlgebra.commRing at Defs.lean:944--945, and AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single from the to_additive attribute and lemma at Defs.lean:548--550. The canonical Q-algebra structure is inferred. The LieRing and Q-LieAlgebra structures are ExtendScalars.instLieRing and instBaseLieAlgebra (BaseChange.lean:106,112); bracket_tmul (line 61) gives the bracket formula. loopAlgebra is definitionally AddMonoidAlgebra Q Gamma tensor L (Loop.lean:65); LoopAlgebra.toFinsupp (line 112) gives the linear isomorphism, and toFinsupp_single_tmul (lines 121--123) its displayed equation. No grading, quotient or other theorem must be proved to specialize these declarations. Source ranges BaseChange:38--114 and Loop:56--123 were read.
